metadata.title: China Lider la AI, Apple dă în judecată OpenAI, Prețul la KWh, Starlink de 1 Gigabit #CURIOSITY 335
metadata.speaker: George Buhnici

executive_takeaway: The highest-signal ideas from Curiosity 335: (1) China's Kimi K3 model (2.8T parameters, 1M context tokens) was launched and is positioned as the most advanced AI model globally, surpassing GPT-5.6 and Anthropic's Fable 5 in benchmark performance while being cheaper. (2) The speakers predict this will be an 'earthquake' in the AI market, forcing American companies to react as Chinese labs close the performance gap. (3) XAI (Elon Musk) faces a major data privacy controversy after it was discovered that Grok Build copies entire user databases during coding sessions. (4) Hardware discussion covers RAM price increases (13-18% in Q3) and the need for local AI processing hardware. (5) Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 rumors suggest minimal improvements over Z Fold 7, with better value found in Honor devices.

actionable_takeaways.item: Test Kimi K3 for coding/research tasks; compare benchmark claims with actual usage
Use Enterprise tier or local AI for sensitive code; free tiers send data to providers
Wait for Samsung Z Fold 7 price drop instead of Z Fold 8 at €2200
Verify Kimi K3 benchmark scores on Artificial Analysis / official leaderboards
Consider local AI hardware (Nvidia Spark, Ryzen Halo) if privacy-critical workloads
Monitor RAM prices; delay non-essential PC builds until 2027 or buy used DDR4
Investigate XAI data collection practices before using Grok Build for proprietary work

other_notable_news.title: XAI / Grok Build copies entire user databases
other_notable_news.detail: During coding sessions Grok Build copied gigabytes of user data (Google Drive buckets), not just 115-120KB. Opt-out only for Enterprise tier; free/Pro/Business tiers send everything to the provider.

other_notable_news.title: Apple sues OpenAI over stolen trade secrets
other_notable_news.detail: Apple dropped OpenAI from Siri after allegations OpenAI recruited Apple hardware VP Tang Tan and engineers who brought laptops/parts. Jony Ive also signed with Sam Altman to build AI devices — seen as a direct attack on Apple's hardware turf.

other_notable_news.title: Microsoft Patch Tuesday sets record: 570 vulnerabilities
other_notable_news.detail: Including 2 zero-days already exploited. Accenture also breached: 35GB of code and keys stolen. AI-powered ransomware group 'Jade Puffer' now sells 'educational services' teaching others to do it.

other_notable_news.title: Personal server audit anecdote
other_notable_news.detail: Speaker found an outdated Grafana (2023) with 2 zero-days exposed; a backup SSD had 110% wear writing 500GB/day for 3 years due to a crashing script. Recommendation: use AI (Fable) to audit your own servers and set up Telegram uptime alerts.

other_notable_news.title: Nvidia in talks for Romanian data centers
other_notable_news.detail: Nvidia in advanced discussions to connect facilities to the Romanian grid; pitches Romania as 'Norway of Central/Eastern Europe.' Needs gigawatts of constant, cheap power.

other_notable_news.title: Cernavodă nuclear risk to energy prices
other_notable_news.detail: Reactor 1 going into refurbishment leaves only Reactor 2 active; kW hit €1 at peak recently. Reactors 3 & 4 still undecided. Geothermal in northern Bucharest cited as untapped 'almost unlimited' electricity source.

other_notable_news.title: Sam Altman proposes US state stake in AI labs
other_notable_news.detail: Suggested US government take 5% (expanding to 10%) public-fund stake in AI labs — like Norway's oil fund — so the state benefits from AI earnings rather than regulating harshly.

other_notable_news.title: Starlink V3 satellites: 1 Tbps per satellite
other_notable_news.detail: Launch delayed (engine failure at T-0, 2 Raptors swapped). New gen = 10x improvement (96GB -> 1 Tbps), 61 Tbps per launch, theoretical 5ms latency (approaching fiber). Satellites 3x heavier (2t) but 10-20x better.

other_notable_news.title: SpaceX Starship Flight 13 scrubbed
other_notable_news.detail: Test flight for Starship v3 + 20 Starlink V3 sats aborted at T-0; attempting Raptor engine restart and booster recovery on retry next week.

other_notable_news.title: Longevity boom — ~$4B invested in past year
other_notable_news.detail: Peptides/treatments funded heavily; warning that 'longevity' is becoming a marketing slogan (cosmetics) with expected abuse. Real 'miracle pills' ignored: sleep (90% of health), weightlifting, sauna (60% lower CV risk for men 40+), colonoscopy after 45.

other_notable_news.title: Climbing deaths in Romanian Alps & Bucegi
other_notable_news.detail: 2 Romanian climbers (Emil Gheorghe, Cornel Roman) died in Italian Alps crevasse; a 36-yr-old dentist (Antonia) died in Bucegi after 10m fall — 4 people belayed at a single point (should be 2+). Glacier melt from climate change creating unstable snow bridges. Rule: 2 rope points on ascent, 3 points (2 feet + stick) on descent.

other_notable_news.title: Movie: Odyssey (Nolan) / Podcast: Skeptics Guide to the Universe
other_notable_news.detail: Odyssey (Matt Damon, Tom Holland, Robert Pattinson) doing well in theaters despite internet controversy. Podcast 'The Skeptics Guide to the Universe' (Steven Novella) recommended for critical thinking / weekly science news.

other_notable_news.title: Prispa Resort, Vișeul de Sus
other_notable_news.detail: Filmed from Prispa Resort; recommends pistachio soufflé and mountain climbing with advance Mountain Rescue notice. Wild blueberries/raspberries abundant. George set up Wi-Fi for Salvamont at 1800-1900m.

other_notable_news.title: International eSIMs via gb.ro
other_notable_news.detail: 50 RON for Greece (10GB); better coverage than Airalo/Holafly/Revolut in island countries (Greece, Italy, Spain). Can activate before departure; company billing available.
